body.statement: There is an algorithm which, from \(\mathfrak G\in\mathfrak E\) and \(m\in\mathbb N\), outputs a finite rational class \(\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\), one common core radius, a common recession fan refining every nonempty component \(P_{v,b}\) with all incidence maps and semantic projections, rational chart meshes, rational partitions of unity, and a computable number \(\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\downarrow0\) such that for every \(K\in\mathcal C_{\eta}\) there exists \(\widetilde K_m\in\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\) whose semantic-label coverage is at least \(1-\eta-\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\), whose separated risk is at most \(R_r(K)+D\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\), and whose complete weighted ledger satisfies \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\le\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\).
body.justification: The theorem remains the global kernel: common-ray coherence is necessary but not sufficient for the promised finite auditable search.
body.gap: The remaining gap is an actual face-to-cone Gaussian-weighted approximation and translated-mean preservation theorem, not commutativity of averaging factors.
body.consumer: Conditional CertGluePFL termination and replayable Gaussian certificates continue to consume it.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove that one finite common-ray library has vanishing face-to-cone Gaussian-weighted discrepancy while simultaneously preserving semantic coverage and separated risk uniformly over every translated mean.
obligation.obstruction: Commutativity yields a path-independent product of averaging operators, but it does not bound the difference between a face rule and the incident cone rule obtained by adding a ray average. For an arbitrary bounded ancestor this difference can remain of order one on a fixed Gaussian neighborhood as the averaging length grows. The available translation estimate controls shifts of the averaged rule itself, and one-sided recession averaging preserves coverage only along labelwise recession directions; neither fact supplies the required simultaneous global separated-risk comparison.
obligation.attempted: The established route starts from one Gaussian-smoothed ancestor, uses a common rational simplicial fan with literally shared one-dimensional Folner factors, shares finite-element variables on common faces, reports the full label set on transition bands, and applies weighted path telescoping. This closes the operator cocycle, incidence-path independence, and translation boundary ratios, but no valid step turns those facts into a vanishing face-to-cone discrepancy or a uniform translated-mean risk bound.
obligation.partial_result:
Starting from the single ancestor \(q_s=K*\phi_{s^2\Sigma}\), the established
common-ray construction proves, for every face inclusion
\(\tau\preceq\sigma\),
\[
 q_{\sigma,L}=
 \left(\prod_{\varrho\in\mathscr R(\sigma)\setminus\mathscr R(\tau)}
 \mathsf A_{\varrho,L}\right)q_{\tau,L},
\]
independently of the incidence path, and proves the uniform translation
bounds
\[
 \|q_{\sigma,L}(w+a\varrho)-q_{\sigma,L}(w)\|_1
 \leq2\min\{1,a/L\},
 \qquad
 |F^f_{\sigma,L}(w+a\varrho)-F^f_{\sigma,L}(w)|
 \leq R_f\min\{1,a/L\}.
\]
Together with Gaussian smoothing, one-chart averaging, and weighted path
telescoping, every fixed finite library has the computable ledger terms
\[
 R_f\min\{1,s^2\sqrt{d/8}\},\qquad
 \frac{R_fk}{T\sqrt{2\pi}},\qquad
 \sum_e\Gamma_{C,e}^f+\frac{R_f}{2}\omega(h).
\]
The missing implication is a uniform vanishing bound for the
Gaussian-weighted difference between an incident cone rule and its face
rule, while simultaneously preserving semantic coverage on every \(D_v\)
and risk on \(H_r\) over all translated means.
